resources.string: DiPlay creates the hotspot and sends its details to your iPhone. No name or password to enter.
For a 2.4 GHz session, car Bluetooth is suspended after Wi-Fi handoff and restored when CarPlay ends. Other Bluetooth devices disconnect during that session.
Creating a temporary hotspot and checking its real network settings.
Hotspot details were sent automatically. Keep iPhone Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on and accept its CarPlay prompt.
Turn off the car’s existing shared hotspot, then retry. Or choose the car hotspot option.
The car could not provide a usable temporary hotspot. Open connection settings to use the car hotspot, or export the report.
Turn on system Location and allow location access for DiPlay, then retry. Android 9 requires this to create a hotspot.
Bluetooth was not restored. Turn it on in car settings, then return to DiPlay.
